heard: The heavens are yours and yours the earth. You founded the world and all that fills it. North and south you created by your word. Tabor and Hermon sing for joy at your name. Yours is an arm of power and might Your hand is strong, your right hand lifted high Righteousness and justice hold your throne Love and faithfulness go before you Blessed are the people who know the festal shout Who walk, Lord, in the light of your face They rejoice in Your name all day long In Your right hand they sing
